title: Драка из-за Вики и увольнение Макса  (Fighting Over Vika and Firing Max)

segments.t: Out of Vika's sight, the confrontation turns physical when Aleksandr lands a punch on Max and then spins a story when Vika rushes over. The next morning in the kitchen, Aleksandr informs Max that he is no longer sous-chef—in fact, he is fired.
Лавров, а у меня для тебя новость.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'My sister, I mean.' The grammar packs 'sister' and 'sense' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Vika answers right away.
'Give me your hand.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'your' and finishing on 'hand'.
'She is going to like it very much.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to her' before landing on 'will please'.
'Okay? Listen here?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'okay' and finishing on 'listen'. Vika answers right away.
'What are we going to do, huh?' The meaning hinges on 'what' working together with 'and' in spoken Russian.
'Our dance of love is only just beginning.' Max anchors the line on 'our', while 'starts' completes the thought.
'Hold on a second.' In Russian, the idea of 'go on' flows naturally into 'wait' without extra filler words. Vika answers right away.
'Max, Max!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Max' before landing on 'Max'.
'Why did he hit you like that?' Notice how Russian expresses 'behind' and 'like this' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'It was nothing.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'like this'. Vika answers right away.
Лавров, а у меня для тебя новость.
'Lavrov, I have news for you.' The grammar packs 'Lavrov' and 'news' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'If you do not like it, get lost, got it?' Max brings out the contrast between 'not' and 'to organize' in a few short words.
'Come over here!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'go' and finishing on 'here'. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Лавров, а у меня для тебя новость.
